papers.title: ORION Research Science Engine
papers.current_ceiling: The controlled governance-conformance result is supported. A same-programme R1 decision harvest is now recovered on main, but the wiring pilot remains NOT_AUTHORITY and R2/R3 authority is open.
post_matrix_updates: Commit 87e2bcb recovered raw R1 attempts/decision records and the R1–R3 execution plan.
Recovery of model outputs strengthens evidence custody but does not create blinded external-human or longitudinal authority.
load_bearing_adverse: P14A is a measurement that could not be taken, not a comparative negative.
P14B is diagnostic because it reuses its own adjudication function.
The wiring pilot is explicitly NOT_AUTHORITY.
Retrospective replay cannot become prospective longitudinal R3 evidence.
papers.strongest_remaining_gap: The flagship gap is independent evaluation of useful discovery, false novelty/overclaim and longitudinal negative-history retention under frontier-agent, blinded expert and history-ablation arms.
papers.decisive_question: On hidden research packets, does the frozen ORION governance process improve independently adjudicated useful discovery and reduce false promotion relative to frontier-agent and checklist baselines, and does removing negative history degrade decisions over time?
papers.maximum_claim_if_supported: Evidence-governed research management improves the quality and safety of research decisions under independent agents, blinded experts and prospective longitudinal evaluation.
papers.hypothesis_or_theorem: The full process should increase useful-discovery recall at a fixed/lower false-promotion rate, retain adverse history and outperform history-ablated variants under matched access and resources.
papers.population_or_universe: The frozen 67-packet suite plus prospectively scheduled longitudinal packets, with positive, null, negative, subsumed and non-identifiable cases across at least three domains.
papers.unit_of_analysis: Research packet × system/ablation × independent adjudicator, with longitudinal sequences as clusters.
historical_only_inputs: Any packet used in the wiring pilot or recovered internal R1 dryruns for authority claims
design: Preserve the recovered R1 outputs as same-programme evidence with exact labels.
Run R2 through blinded external experts who did not design the system or gold.
Run R3 only prospectively as new negative-history events accrue.
Match literature/tool access and resource budgets across systems.
Separate useful discovery, false novelty, overclaim, abstention and cost.
negative_controls: History-dependent packet where a prior adverse result is necessary.
Pilot/dryrun packet inserted as leakage canary.
analysis_plan: Blinded packet-level paired analysis and adjudicator agreement model.
R3 uses prospective time ordering and cannot be backfilled.
Same-programme R1 is reported separately from external R2 and temporal R3.
papers.power_or_exhaustion_rule: Use the frozen packet suite for R2 and prospectively accumulate the predeclared R3 sequence count; expert count and agreement model are frozen before adjudication.
papers.success_gate: Independent R2 shows useful-discovery benefit without false-promotion harm, and prospective R3 shows a predeclared degradation when negative history is ablated under matched resources.
papers.refutation_gate: No R2 advantage, false-promotion increase or no R3 history effect limits the result to controlled governance conformance.
papers.cannot_check_gate: CANNOT_CHECK if experts are not independent/blinded, system access is unmatched, R3 chronology is retrospective or adjudicator disagreement cannot be resolved under the frozen rule.
papers.authority_required: Blinded external experts/institutions for R2 and naturally prospective temporal authority for R3; same-programme agents are not sufficient.

active_lane.reference: PR #1691 shared acquisition; recovered R1–R3 plan; #1701 / #1729
active_lane.collision_rule: Do not duplicate shared acquisition or relabel recovered same-programme outputs as blinded external R2/R3 authority.

immediate_safe_actions: Audit recovered R1 records for exact system/evaluator labels.
Recruit and freeze an independent blinded R2 adjudication panel.
Protect the R3 calendar and negative-history events from retrospective substitution.
forbidden_actions: Do not call the wiring pilot authority.
Do not call same-programme agents external experts.
Do not backfill R3 from retrospective replays.
papers.journal_bar: A top-tier research-methods/AI paper needs independent blinded evaluation, meaningful discovery and overclaim endpoints, prospective longitudinal ablation, matched resources and preserved adverse history.
papers.sibling_boundary: Owns end-to-end research governance; claim authorization belongs to ORION-18 and execution custody to ORION-25.
